analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: Benzodiazepine agonists act on GABA-A receptor subunits that are largely neuronal and minimally expressed in these cell lines, so transcriptional response should be weak; the closest reference classes are other GABA/benzodiazepine-site ligands that share the same receptor system and similarly limited expression.
